description: This file defines the MysqlManager class, which extends the DBManager class and provides MySQL-specific database management functionality, including connection handling, query execution, schema manipulation, and database information retrieval.

classes.name: MysqlManager
classes.description: A PHP class implementing MySQL-specific database management operations, including connection setup, query execution, schema modifications, and utility functions tailored for MySQL.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, handling array input and logging; manages the query execution and result handling.

methods.name: getAffectedRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a query result (deprecated).

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the database connection and frees resources.

methods.name: freeDbResult
methods.description: Frees the database result resource.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if the SQL query contains a LIMIT clause.

methods.name: limitQuery
methods.description: Applies a LIMIT to a SQL query and executes it.

methods.name: checkQuery
methods.description: Analyzes the EXPLAIN plan of a query for potential performance issues.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Retrieves column descriptions for a table.

methods.name: getFieldsArray
methods.description: Returns an array of field names from a result set.

methods.name: fetchRow
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the result set.

methods.name: getTablesArray
methods.description: Returns a list of tables in the current database.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Retrieves the MySQL version.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks whether a table exists in the database.

methods.name: tablesLike
methods.description: Returns tables matching a pattern.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Escapes a string for use in SQL queries.

methods.name: quoteIdentifier
methods.description: Quotes an identifier such as a table or column name.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database using provided configuration.

methods.name: repairTableParams
methods.description: Reconstructs and executes an ALTER TABLE statement to modify a table's schema.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a value or expression into a database-specific SQL expression.

methods.name: fromConvert
methods.description: Converts a database-specific expression back to a PHP value/error.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the storage engine for a given bean object.

methods.name: isEngineEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether a specific storage engine is enabled in MySQL.

methods.name: createTableSQL
methods.description: Generates the SQL for creating a table based on a Bean object.

methods.name: createTableSQLParams
methods.description: Creates the CREATE TABLE SQL statement based on table name, fields, indices, and engine.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Determines if a column type represents text data.

methods.name: oneColumnSQLRep
methods.description: Generates the SQL fragment for a single column definition.

methods.name: changeColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to modify a column in a table.

methods.name: keysSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for index and key definitions inside CREATE TABLE.

methods.name: setAutoIncrement
methods.description: Returns SQL to set auto increment property (placeholder).

methods.name: setAutoIncrementStart
methods.description: Sets the next auto-increment value for a table.

methods.name: getAutoIncrement
methods.description: Retrieves the current auto-increment value for a table.

methods.name: get_indices
methods.description: Retrieves index definitions on a table.

methods.name: add_drop_constraint
methods.description: Generates SQL to add or drop constraints and indexes.

methods.name: fetchOne
methods.description: Executes a query and fetches a single row.

methods.name: full_text_indexing_installed
methods.description: Checks if full-text indexing (MyISAM) is available.

methods.name: massageFieldDef
methods.description: Adjusts a field definition before schema operations.

methods.name: dropTableNameSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a table if it exists.

methods.name: dropIndexes
methods.description: Drops specified indexes from a table.

methods.name: getCollation
methods.description: Retrieves the collation setting.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Retrieves the character set setting.

methods.name: getDefaultCollation
methods.description: Returns the default collation.

methods.name: getDefaultCharset
methods.description: Returns the default charset.

methods.name: getCollationList
methods.description: Lists available collations.

methods.name: renameColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a column.

methods.name: emptyValue
methods.description: Returns the default 'empty' value for a given type.

methods.name: lastDbError
methods.description: Returns the last database error message.

methods.name: quoteTerm
methods.description: Quotes a search term for full-text search.

methods.name: getFulltextQuery
methods.description: Builds a full-text search query string.

methods.name: getCharsetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about available character sets.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Provides database client info and settings.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates a query's EXPLAIN plan.

methods.name: makeTempTableCopy
methods.description: Creates a temporary copy of a table for testing schema changes.

methods.name: verifyAlterTable
methods.description: Tests an ALTER TABLE query schema change.

methods.name: verifyGenericReplaceQuery
methods.description: Tests schema modification queries like DROP, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE.

methods.name: verifyDropTable
methods.description: Tests dropping a table schema.

methods.name: verifyInsertInto
methods.description: Tests inserting data into a table.

methods.name: verifyUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating data in a table.

methods.name: verifyDeleteFrom
methods.description: Tests deleting data from a table.

methods.name: dbExists
methods.description: Checks for existence of a database.

methods.name: selectDb
methods.description: Selects a database.

methods.name: userExists
methods.description: Checks if a database user exists.

methods.name: createDbUser
methods.description: Creates a new database user.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops a database.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the driver can be used.

methods.name: canInstall
methods.description: Verifies MySQL version compatibility for installation.

methods.name: installConfig
methods.description: Provides configuration info for installation.

methods.name: disableKeys
methods.description: Disables keys for a table temporarily.

methods.name: enableKeys
methods.description: Re-enables keys for a table.

methods.name: getFromDummyTable
methods.description: Provides a dummy FROM clause if needed.

methods.name: getGuidSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL expression for generating UUIDs.
